name: terminal_residual_diagnosis_v1
source: corrected v3 terminal_endpose_learned runs; previously validation-selected checkpoints
test_protocol: same frozen 60-sample stride-10 test windows; no new model or checkpoint selection
primary_cohort: 201 pure-future windows with both hand references, before any terminal target aggregation capture
primary_hand: ground-truth receiving hand for learned residual and persistence
diagnostic_hand: predicted hand, with matching predicted-hand persistence; classification differences reported separately
angle_policy: report angles only when both actual and predicted displacements are at least 2 cm; descriptive threshold, not a validated sensor-noise bound
decomposition: squared position error = squared magnitude difference + 2*(actual_length*predicted_length-dot(actual,predicted)); geometric identity, not a causal attribution
aggregation: per-seed window means and equal-recording means; mean and sample SD across three seeds; paired keys identical across checkpoints
partial_overlap: preserved separately, excluded from primary residual analysis
statistics: descriptive post-hoc diagnosis; overlapping windows are not independent trials; seed SD is not participant uncertainty
